changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_sender_stage_status

ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ( 'DISCOVERED', 'STAGED', 'QUEUED_FOR_CP', 'CP_CONSUMED', 'ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING', 'CP_TIMEOUT', 'EXENSIO_MONITORING', 'COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED', 'COMPLETED', 'CP_FAILED', 'LOAD_FAILED', 'CANCELLED' ))

changeSet.author: exensioreload
changeSet.comment:
Rename STAGED_TO_REFDB to STAGED for database-agnostic naming.
Old -> New: - STAGED_TO_REFDB -> STAGED
This avoids coupling status names to a specific database (REFDB). The meaning is identical: the file has been inserted into the staging table.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'STAGED' WHERE status = 'STAGED_TO_REFDB'

ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ( 'DISCOVERED', 'STAGED', 'QUEUED_FOR_CP', 'CP_CONSUMED', 'ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING', 'CP_TIMEOUT', 'EXENSIO_MONITORING', 'COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED', 'COMPLETED', 'CP_FAILED', 'LOAD_FAILED', 'CANCELLED' ))

rollback.sql: UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'STAGED_TO_REFDB' WHERE status = 'STAGED'

ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ( 'DISCOVERED', 'STAGED_TO_REFDB', 'QUEUED_FOR_CP', 'CP_CONSUMED', 'ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING', 'CP_TIMEOUT', 'EXENSIO_MONITORING', 'COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED', 'COMPLETED', 'CP_FAILED', 'LOAD_FAILED', 'CANCELLED' ))
